purpose: Interactive control for user actions. Lives at `packages/webkit/src/components/actions/icon-button/`.
useWhen: Compact actions in toolbars, table rows, card headers and overlay close controls where the glyph is widely understood (close, refresh, delete, more).
Swapping between two icons in place (copy to check, show to hide), with `iconTransition` animating the change.
An icon-only link: set `href` and it renders as an anchor.
avoidWhen: The action needs a visible label → use `button`.
Copying a value to the clipboard → use `copy-button`, which already wires the icon swap, the tooltip and the `copy` event.
Choosing one of a few mutually exclusive options → use `toggle-group`.
related: button` — labelled counterpart; sizes line up and its `text` kind matches `transparent` here.
copy-button` — IconButton plus Tooltip with the clipboard write built in.
tooltip` — wrap an IconButton to show its name on hover and focus.
split-button` — uses an IconButton as its chevron menu toggle.
bestPractices: Always name it with the kebab attribute `aria-label="Delete domain"` (`:aria-label` when the name changes, `aria-labelledby` when visible text already names it). Describe the action ("Delete domain"), not the glyph ("Trash"). Write `aria-label`, never the camelCase `ariaLabel` attribute: Vue maps the kebab attribute onto the `ariaLabel` prop, and it is the form every other attribute takes in a template.

The `ariaLabel` prop is optional in the types on purpose: vue-tsc does not camelize `aria-*` attributes onto props, so a required `ariaLabel` made the obvious `aria-label="…"` fail to type-check in a fresh create-vue app. The lint rule `webkit/accessible-name` keeps the name required instead: it flags an `IconButton` with neither `aria-label` nor `aria-labelledby`.
Wrap it in `tooltip` when the glyph is not self-evident, so pointer users see the name screen readers hear.
Use `kind="transparent"` in dense rows and toolbars; keep `primary` for a lone emphasized action.
Set `iconTransition` only when `icon` changes at runtime; with a static icon it adds nothing.
Use `iconClass` for glyph-level tweaks instead of styling the root.
